name: 95619 · Diamond Spgs, CA
findings: ZIP 95619 (Diamond Spgs) has 12 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (60% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95619 (Diamond Spgs) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
